limits: Validation pool helped select checkpoints; this is not an untouched quality test
One window is diagnostic coverage, not statistical replication
Probability effects are descriptive; no quality-equivalence threshold
No optimizer, weight updates or BF16 full-model gradient certification
Retain all failures and original tolerances
Timing includes checks and hashing; no throughput ranking
Validation data helped select these checkpoints; this is not an independent language-quality test.
Next-token probability/NLL changes and greedy agreement are descriptive; no quality-equivalence cutoff is applied.
The one-token default suffix makes one-shot/tokenwise continuation identical in call shape; use length257 for a longer suffix.
FP32 gradients compare only the two portable scan paths at the recorded shapes; BF16 full-model gradient parity is unexecuted.
Real prefix states cover only the recorded natural windows, not every reachable state or future context.
Processing time includes transfers, hashing and checks; it is not a throughput benchmark.
No optimizer, training, fused scan, production precision change or backend certification.
Exporter rechecks source/registry identities and the natural window; binary checkpoint/training-stream hashes remain bound to the pre-run declaration and recorded integrity audit.
Source verification recognizes LF/CRLF versions of the same text while preserving recorded byte hashes.
Descriptive-statistic validation allows FP32 reduction rounding only; tensor tolerances and quality conclusions are unchanged.
